$comment: Curated Agents surfaced under Build > Registry > Agents. These are 'Agents' in the AVA sense — MCP-callable / runtime-bound / auto-registered — NOT A2A-protocol peers (those live in A2A Servers). Records write to AWS Agent Registry with recordType=AGENT and tag Kind=agent to distinguish from A2A (Kind=a2a).

agents.name: AWS DevOps Agent
agents.description: AWS-managed DevOps agent — troubleshoots pipeline failures, deployment rollbacks, and CloudFormation drift. Callable via AgentCore Runtime endpoint. No user-hosted infrastructure.

agents.name: AWS Security Agent
agents.description: AWS-managed security agent — investigates findings from GuardDuty, Security Hub, and IAM Access Analyzer; proposes remediation. Read-mostly; requires explicit approval before applying changes.

agents.name: Kiro (Dev Agent)
agents.description: AWS-managed development agent — code review, unit test drafting, refactor suggestions. IDE-integrated; also callable as a peer from other agents when a code-question step is needed.

agents.name: Sample FSI KYC Agent (reference)
agents.description: Reference implementation of a KYC triage agent — screens applicant profiles against sanctions/PEP lists, escalates with regulation citations. Ships as a deployable FSI Foundry use case; register it here if you want other agents to delegate to it.
